description: A steel bulb of nitrous oxide. Forty seconds, and then you are just a person in a room again.

effects.comeon_message: Cold on the teeth, sweet at the back of the throat.

events.text: [trip]WAH. WAH. WAH. The whole room is on the beat.[/trip]
[trip]You are laughing and the laugh arrives in slices.[/trip]
[trip]The beat slows. Something almost gets explained.[/trip]
[trip]Gone. You are standing in a room holding a balloon, and it is a bit embarrassing.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: Everything becomes a throb with a beat to it, and the beat is very funny, and the room agrees.

overdose.message: You breathe nothing but the gas for too long, and the part of you that was supposed to notice has gone out.

effects.take_line: You crack the {name} into a balloon and breathe it back in.

withdrawal.message: Your hands and feet are buzzing and have been for days. It is not the good buzzing.

name: whippet
